summary: 4 new acceptance criteria (CareSetu rebrand, quick-choice symptom UX, mobile stability) covered with 1 new backend pytest file (2 cases) and 4 new named browser checks. Fixed one stale backend assertion in test_tscheck_doctor_access.py that pre-dated the rename. Full backend suite (21 cases, 7 files) and all 12 browser checks (8 prior + 4 new) pass.

checks.criterion: All user-visible product branding is renamed from TECHNEXA to CareSetu
checks.name: test_tscheck_branding_caresetu.py
checks.evidence: GET /api/ -> 200 {"message":"CareSetu demo API ready","mode":"deterministic_demo"} (contains 'caresetu', no 'technexa'); GET /api/demo/state -> 200, response body contains no 'technexa' substring

checks.criterion: All user-visible product branding is renamed from TECHNEXA to CareSetu
checks.name: branding-caresetu-no-technexa
checks.evidence: Page title 'CareSetu · Smart Healthcare Demo' contains CareSetu / no TECHNEXA; header shows 'CareSetu' brand mark; full page innerText contains no 'technexa' substring. Verified once on localhost and once through APP_URL (https://attachment-tool-3.preview.emergentagent.com) ingress.

checks.criterion: The first symptom step offers fast common choices plus a flexible custom path
checks.name: symptom-quick-first-step-choices
checks.evidence: After tapping Check My Symptoms, quick-choice panel shows Headache/Fever or chills/Stomach discomfort/Tired or weak + 'Describe something else'; tapping 'Describe something else' focuses symptom-description-input without starting an assessment; tapping 'Headache' (a common choice) immediately opens assessment-question-card (question 1).

checks.criterion: Every symptom follow-up offers one-tap choices while retaining Other text input
checks.name: symptom-followups-quick-choices-to-guidance
checks.evidence: Q1 shows Today/Yesterday/2-7 days ago/More than a week + Other; Q2 shows Getting better/Unchanged/Getting worse/Comes and goes + Other; Q3 shows No/Difficulty breathing/Feeling faint/Both + Other; choosing one tap per question with zero manual typing reaches assessment-normal-result containing 'please consult a doctor'.

checks.criterion: The optimized patient assessment is mobile accessible and stable
checks.name: mobile-assessment-stable-no-overflow
checks.evidence: At 390x844, document.documentElement.scrollWidth - clientWidth <= 1 at every step (panel open, and after each of 3 quick-tap answers, and at final guidance); quick-choice button touch target height >= 40px; zero requestfailed events and zero HTTP responses >=400 captured across the full choice-only journey.
